core_obligations: Apply the cohomological functor represented by F to the Mayer-Vietoris triangle for extension by zero to obtain a long exact sequence of Hom groups (proof lines 8186-8190).

Rewrite each term using the adjunction between extension by zero and restriction, so that the Hom from the extension by zero of a restriction becomes the Hom of the restrictions on the open (proof lines 8191-8196).
Identify the resulting sequence with the displayed one, whose tail involves the Ext groups in negative degrees (proof lines 8172-8183).
proof_roadmap: Long exact sequence from the triangle (proof lines 8186-8190).
Rewriting the terms by adjunction (proof lines 8191-8196).
difficulty_reason: For a ringed space which is the union of two open subspaces and objects E and F of the derived category, the lemma produces a long exact Mayer-Vietoris sequence relating the Hom groups of the restrictions to U, V and their intersection and ending in Ext groups (statement lines 8166-8184). The proof takes the distinguished triangle expressing the extension by zero of the intersection in terms of the extensions by zero of U and V and of the object itself, applies the cohomological functor represented by F to obtain a long exact sequence of Hom groups, and then rewrites each term using the adjunction between extension by zero and restriction to an open (proof lines 8186-8196). The claim is H2: one triangle from a preceding lemma plus one adjunction, with the identification of the terms written out as a displayed formula.
